questions.question: 12 years ago, the ratio of the ages of Ram and Laxman was 2 : 1. After 13 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 9 : 7. The sum of their present ages is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

12 years ago, the ratio of the ages of Ram and Laxman was 2: 1

After 13 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 9: 7

**Calculations:**

Let the present age of Ram = x years

The present age of Laxman = y years

According to the question,

12 years ago, the ratio of the ages of Ram and Laxman was 2: 1

(x-12)/(y-12)=(2)/(1)

x - 12 = 2y - 24

2y - x = 12 ........(1)

Now, After 13 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 9: 7

(x+13)/(y+13)=(9)/(7)

7x + 91 = 9y + 117

7x - 9y = 26 ..........(2)

Multiply eq (1) by 7 and add with eq (2), we get

14y - 7x + 7x - 9y = 84 + 26

5y = 110

y = 22

Put the value of y in eq (1), and we get

2 x 22 - x = 12

x= 44 - 12

x= 32

Sum of the ages of Ram and Laxman = x + y = 32 + 22= 54 years

**Hence, The sum of the ages of Ram and Laxman is 54 years**

questions.question: If (x + y) = 17, xy = 9, then what is the value of x³ + y³ ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y = 17

xy = 9

**Formula Used:**

(a+b)³=a³+b³+3a²b+3ab²

**Calculations:**

According to the formula,

⇒ (x+y)³=x³+y³+3x²y+3xy²

⇒ x³+y³=(x+y)³-3xy(x+y)

⇒ x³+y³=(17)³-3×9(17)=4913 - 459= 4454

**Hence, The value of x³+y³** **is 4454**

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio of 5 : 7 and their LCM is 385. Find the numbers.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two numbers are in the ratio of 5 : 7

Their LCM is 385

**Concept Used:**

The LCM is the Lowest Common Factor of one or more than one number

**Calculations:**

⇒ The ratio of two number= 5:7

⇒ Let 1st Number= 5x

⇒ 2nd Number= 7x

⇒ LCM of these number = 35x

According to the question,

⇒ LCM= 385

⇒ 35x= 385

⇒ x = 11

⇒ 1st number= 5x= 5 x 11 = 55

⇒ 2nd number= 7x= 7x 11= 77

**Hence, The numbers are 55 and 77**

questions.question: A person can row downstream 49 km in 7 hours and upstream 36 km in 9 hours. What is the speed of the current?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A person can row downstream 49 km in 7 hours

Upstream 36 km in 9 hours

**Formula Used:**

For Downstream

Speed of boat + Speed of Stream = Downstream speed

For Upstream

Speed of boat - Speed of Stream = Upstream speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Speed of boat= x km/h

⇒ Speed of Stream= y km/h

⇒ Downstream Speed = (Distance)/(Time)=(49)/(7)= 7 km/h

⇒ Upstream Speed = (Distance)/(Time)=(36)/(9)= 4 km/h

According to the formula,

⇒ x + y = 7 ..........(1)

⇒ x - y = 4 ..........(2)

Subtract eq (1) from (2)

⇒ 2y = 3

⇒ y = 1.5 km/h

**Hence, The speed of the stream will be 1.5 km/h**

If upstream speed = U, downstream speed = D, then,

Speed of Boat = (D + U)/2, and speed of Current = (D - U)/2,

Here, downstream speed = 49/7 = 7 km/h

Upstream speed = 36/9 = 4 km/h

Then, speed of the current = (7 - 4)/2 = 1.5 km/h

questions.question: The average of twelve numbers is 25. If each number is added by 6, then the new average will be:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average of twelve numbers is 25

**FORMULA USED:**

Average = Sum of values/Number of values

**CALCULATION:**

Here, average of 12 numbers = 25

⇒ Average = Sum of values/No. of values

⇒ 25 = Sum of values/12

⇒ Sum of values = 25 × 12 = 300

Now, according to the question,

Each number is added by 6,

⇒ 12 × 6 = 72 

New sum of values = 300 + 72 = 372

⇒ New average = 372/12 = 31

**Hence, new average is 31.**

questions.question: The mean of 10 numbers is 0. If 38 and -2 are included in these numbers, the new mean will be:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Mean of 10 numbers is 0 

**FORMULA USED:**

Mean = Sum of the terms/ Number of terms

**CALCULATION:**

Here, mean of 10 numbers is 0 

⇒ Mean = Sum of the terms/Number of the terms

⇒ 0 = Sum of the terms/10 

⇒ Sum of the terms = 0 

Now, if 38 and -2 are included then,

Number of new terms = 10 + 2 = 12 

Sum of the new terms = 0 + 38 - 2 = 36

⇒ New mean = 36/12 = 3

**Hence, new mean is 3.**

questions.question: A multi-store outlet sold 1375 items in a week earning 25% gain. The gain is also equal to the selling price of 'Q' number of items. What is the value of Q?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A multi-store outlet sold 1375 items in a week earning 25% gain

The gain is also equal to the selling price of 'Q' number of items

**Formula Used:**

Gain%= (SP-CP)/(CP)times 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Selling price(SP)= 1375

⇒ Gain%= 25%

According to the formula,

⇒ Gain%= (SP-CP)/(CP)times 100

⇒ 25=(1375-CP)/(CP)times 100

⇒ 25CP= 137500-100CP

⇒ 125CP=137500

⇒ CP= Rs. 1100

⇒ Number of Items(Q)= Gain= SP - CP= 1375 - 1100= Rs. 275

**Hence, The Number of Item sold is 275 items**

In a typing shop, Lalit can complete typing of a book in 9 days, while Amit can finish the same work in 8 days. How many days will they take together to complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Lalit can complete typing of a book in 9 days

Amit can finish the same work in 8 days

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Time taken x Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total work = x

Lalit can complete typing of a book in 9 days

⇒ Do work in one day(Efficiency)= (x)/(9)

Similarly,

Amit can finish the same work in 8 days

⇒ Do work in one day(Efficiency)= (x)/(8)

⇒ The efficiency of both Lalit and Amit= (x)/(9)+(x)/(8)=(8x+9x)/(72)=(17x)/(72)

According to the formula,

⇒ Total work = Time taken x Efficiency

⇒ Time taken= (Total space work)/(Efficiency)=(x)/(frac{17x){72}}=(72)/(17)=4.23 days

**Hence, The total time taken to typing the book is 4.23 days**

questions.question: A policeman follows a thief, who is 840 meters ahead of him. The thief and the policeman run at a speed of 7.5 km/h and 9 km/h, respectively. What distance (in km) is run by the thief before he is nabbed by the policeman?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A policeman follows a thief, who is 840 meters ahead of him

Speed of thief = 7.5 km/h

Speed of policemen = 9 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Distance= Speed x Time

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Both are running in the same direction

⇒ Relative speed = Speed of policeman - Speed of thief = 9 - 7.5= 1.5 km/h

⇒ Distance(in Km)= 840/1000= 0.84 km

Time is taken to catch the police

⇒ Time= (Distance)/(speed)=(.84)/(1.5)= 0.56 hours

⇒ Distance run by thief= Speed x Time= 7.5 x 0.56= 4.2 km

**Hence, The distance travelled by the thief is 4.2 km**

questions.question: Rohan spends 24% of an amount of money on an insurance policy, 36% on food, 18% on children's education and 14% on recreation. He deposits the remaining amount of Rs. 504 in the bank. What is the total amount that he spends on food and insurance policy together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rohan spends 24% of an amount of money on an insurance policy

36% on food

18% on children's education

14% on recreation

He deposits the remaining amount of Rs. 504

**Concept Used:**

A percentage is a number or ratio that can be expressed as a fraction of 100

**Calculations:**

Total percentage he spend in a month

⇒ Percentage he spent= 24% + 36% + 18% + 14%=92%

⇒ Percentage he deposit= Total percentage - Percentage he spent = 100% - 92%= 8%

According to the question,

⇒ 8%= 504

⇒ 1%= Rs. 63

⇒ Amount he spent on insurance= 24%= 24 x 1%= 24 x 63= Rs. 1512

⇒ Amonut he spent on food= 36%= 36 x 1% = 36 x 63= Rs. 2268

⇒ Total money he spent on food and insurance= Rs. 1512 + Rs. 2268= Rs. 3780

**Hence, Total money he spent on food and insurance is Rs. 3780**

questions.question: Suppose every three adults consume 2 litres of milk, 0.5 kg sugar every day and the daily consumption of every five children is double the milk and half of the sugar than what the three adults consume. A family has 5 adults and 8 children. Their expenditure on milk and sugar, for a month of 30 days, if half-litre milk packets costs Rs. 25 and one kg sugar packet costs Rs. 80, is______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three adults consume 2 liters of milk, and 0.5 kg of sugar every day

Every five children are double the milk and half of the sugar as what the three adults consume

 A family has 5 adults and 8 children

Cost of half a liter of milk= Rs. 25

Cost of 1kg sugar= Rs. 80

**Concept Used:**

Simple calculations of maths by multipling, addition, subtraction or division

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

⇒ 3Adults= 2 liters milk + 0.5kg sugar

⇒ 1Adults= (2)/(3)milk + (1)/(6) sugar

Similarly, 5 Children consume double milk and half sugar as what the three adults consume

⇒ 5Children= of 4 liters milk + (1)/(4)kg sugar

⇒ 1Children= (4)/(5)milk + (1)/(20) sugar

A family has 5 adults and 8 children

The total consumptions of milk and sugar in one day

⇒ 5Adults= (10)/(3)milk + (5)/(6) sugar

⇒ and, 8Children= (32)/(5)milk + (8)/(20) sugar= (32)/(5)milk + (2)/(5) sugar

⇒ Total consumption of milk by 5 adults and 8 children in one day= (10)/(3)+(32)/(5)=(50+96)/(15)=(146)/(15)

⇒ In 30 days total consumption= (146)/(15)×30= 292 of liters mik

⇒ Total consumption of sugar by 5 adults and 8 children in one day= (5)/(6)+(2)/(5)=(25+12)/(30)=(37)/(30)

⇒ In 30 days total consumption= (37)/(30)×30= 37 Kg sugar

⇒ Cost of half a liter of milk= Rs. 25

⇒ Cost of 1 liter milk= Rs. 50

⇒ Cost of 292 liters of milk= 292 x Rs. 50 = Rs. 14600

⇒ Cost of 1 kg of sugar= Rs. 80

⇒ Cost of 37 liters milk= 37 x Rs. 80 = Rs. 2960

⇒ Total expenditure on milk and sugar in a month= Rs. 14600+Rs. 2960= Rs. 17560

**Hence, The total expenditure on milk and sugar in a month by a family is Rs. 17560**

questions.question: A 15% discount is allowed by a tradesman. How much above the cost price (in percentage) must he mark his goods so as to gain 19%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A 15% discount is allowed by a tradesman

Wants a gain 19%

**Formula Used:**

Discount%= (MP-SP)/(MP)×100

Percentage%= (MP-CP)/(CP)×100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the cost price of the article= Rs.100

⇒ SP after getting 19% gain= Rs. 119

According to the formula,

⇒ Discount%= (MP-SP)/(MP)×100

⇒ 15= (MP-119)/(MP)×100

⇒ 15MP= 100MP - 11900

⇒ 85MP= 11900

⇒ MP= Rs. 140

Now,

⇒ Percentage%= (MP-CP)/(CP)×100=(140-100)/(100)×100= 40%

**Hence, The Cost price(in percentage) must be marked above to earn a gain of 19 % is 40%**
